title: Problem 1.1 — ([188, Problem 1]) Find a non-trivial knot K with VK (t) = 1.
exact_target: Find a nontrivial knot whose Jones polynomial equals that of the unknot, or rule out every such knot.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 10400001 (AMR-103-0001). CC BY 4.0.

T. Ohtsuki (editor), \emph{Problems on invariants of knots and 3-manifolds}, Geometry \& Topology Monographs 4 (2002), pp. 377--572 (published 2004), item 1.1 and its surrounding definitions and remarks.
